name: Star Spark Mastery II
description: When the second Charge empowerment is consumed, the remaining Charge detonates for 20 damage.
flavor:
The Charge flashes brightly on your foe's forehead.

There is a very brief moment where everyone realizes what is about to happen.

It explodes.

Your foe finally manages to touch the Charge.

This turns out to be a mistake.

The Charge sparkles one last time.

Your foe looks concerned.

They are correct.

The Charge begins flashing faster and faster.

Your foe appears to understand the situation approximately one second too late.

The Charge has spent quite enough time on your foe's forehead.

It decides to leave violently.

Your foe looks up at the glowing Charge.

The Charge looks back.

This relationship ends explosively.
